description: AX-manager monitoring thresholds; not official TECNO, Unisoc, or Android limits
notes: These are AX-manager monitoring thresholds only. They are not official TECNO, Unisoc, Linux, or Android memory limits. Step 7A changes no memory, swap, ZRAM, sysctl, /proc, or /sys setting. Step 7B recommendations coordinate performance only and do not modify memory settings.
